data.title: bn-ozi5: pack-based snapshot sidecar storage core
data.description:
v1 storage core for ADR 0002's snapshot sidecar, behind the EXISTING SnapshotStore seam (no public trait break — that is deferred to a follow-up bone per the lead's scope ruling).

New: crates/mess-store/src/pack_snapshot/{mod,format,sidecar,tests}.rs and crates/mess-store/tests/pack_snapshot.rs. FjallSnapshotBackend is untouched; the two coexist until adoption (bn-3l8n). Zero new external dependencies (CRC32C via mess_log::crc, the writer lock via mess_log::lock::StoreLock).

Contract essentials covered: discardable-on-any-failure loads; one exclusive OS writer lock with clones sharing a serialized owner and read-only offline readers; one persisted store UUID with a monotone never-reused id space whose high-water is durably reserved; footerless commit-framed bounded CRC'd build pack with writer-only torn-tail truncation; roll = index+footer, sync, seal-rename, dir sync, sealed packs immutable; progressive root fallback with >=2 retained roots; Buffered vs Durable publication with closure promotion; GC-ordered root pruning (no content deletion in v1).

Please scrutinise in particular: (1) the deliberate deviation from ADR 0002's equal-coverage 'different valid state is a conflict, keep current' rule — a single-writer sidecar resolves it last-write-wins because the seam has no way to surface a conflict and load_cached relies on replace; (2) the in-memory-only durability proof ledger (conservative: a reopen re-promotes); (3) the O(N) flat root descriptor per save; (4) the honesty of the crash model (injected abort at named fsync boundaries + byte-level mutilation; no real SIGKILL or power-loss reordering).

Evidence: 42 new unit tests (framing/format + crash suite) and 12 new integration tests, all passing. Full mess-store suite 238/238 pass (MESS_SNAPSHOT_LAW_ITERS=25), cargo check --workspace --all-targets clean, just fmt-check clean, no new clippy warnings.
